title: Trogocytosis-based cell platform for TCR ligand discovery
protocol: Culture HEK-293T cells in 25 mL D10 medium on a 150 mm tissue culture dish at 37°C and 5% atmospheric CO2.
Passage the HEK-293T cells every 2-3 days when confluence reaches 70%.
Remove the culture medium from HEK-293T cells and replace with 4 mL 0.25% trypsin-EDTA solution, then incubate for 5 minutes.
Dilute and quench the reaction by gently pipetting with 10 mL fresh media.
Centrifuge the cells at 500g for 5 minutes.
Count the HEK-293T cells using a hemocytometer.
Reseed 1 million cells in 25 mL D10 medium on a new 150 mm tissue culture dish.
Culture Jurkat and K562 cells in suspension in C10 medium in vent cap cell culture flasks at 37°C and 5% atmospheric CO2.
Passage the Jurkat and K562 cells every 2-3 days when confluence reaches 70%.
Add 1 million cells to a new cell culture flask containing fresh C10 medium for passage.

Generate back-translated nucleotide sequences with the IDT Codon Optimization Tool using "Amino Acids" as input sequence type, "gBlocks Gene Fragments" as product type, and "Homo sapiens (human)" as organism.
Append nucleotide sequences for cloning into a BsmBI digested backbone to the back-translated epitope sequences "CAGGAGGGCTCGGCA" + <epitope sequence> + "GGATGCGGAGGGTCC".
Append random nucleotides to the end of the epitope oligo.
Submit the first 100 bp of each nucleotide sequence with appended random nucleotides for synthesis.
Prepare 1200 μl of digestion buffer including 120 μl of 10X NEB 3.1 Buffer.
Add 48 μl of NEB BsmBI Enzyme to the digestion buffer.
Include 72 μl of backbone plasmid pCCLc-MND-2kb stuffer-β2m-A2-IRES-eGFP at 1 μg/μl.
Add 960 μl of Nuclease-free water to complete the mixture.
Aliquot 100 μl across 12 PCR strips.
Incubate for 6 hours at 55°C.
Heat inactivate enzyme at 80°C for 20 minutes.
Pool all digestion reactions in a 1.5 mL eppendorf tube.
Purify with NucleoSpin Gel and PCR purification kit using one column per 240 μl of digested plasmid (5 columns total).
Elute in 20 μl Elution Buffer per column.
Pool elution in a 1.5 mL eppendorf tube to achieve about 300 ng/μl final concentration.
Prepare 600 μl of second digestion buffer including 60 μl of 10X NEB 3.1 Buffer and 24 μl of NEB BsmBI Enzyme.
Include 100 μl of digested backbone from Step 5a.
Add 416 μl of Nuclease-free water to complete the mixture.
Aliquot 100 μl across 6 PCR strips.
Incubate for 6 hours at 55°C.
Heat inactivate enzyme at 80°C for 20 minutes.
Pool all second digest reactions in a 1.5 mL eppendorf tube (600 μl).
Mix 120 μl of 6X Purple Loading Dye with the digest mixture.
Load the mixture on gel at 65 μl per well (11 total).
Load 10 μl of 2-log Ladder in a remaining empty well.
Run the gel at 120 V for 1 hour or until the dye front has run 75% of the gel.
Image the gel briefly in a gel imager at 365 nm UV wavelength.
Cut out the larger band with a razor and place it in a 2 mL eppendorf tube.
Follow instructions for NucleoSpin Gel and PCR purification kit, using one column per 4 wells of excised plasmid.
Elute in 20 μl Elution Buffer per column.
Pool elutions in a 1.5 mL eppendorf tube.
Dilute or resuspend single-stranded oligo pool to 10 ng/μl with Elution Buffer.
Prepare 600 μl library amplification mix.
Aliquot the mix to 24 wells of a PCR plate or strips.

Amplify according to the program: Initial Denaturation at 95°C for 2 minutes, followed by 6 cycles of denature at 95°C for 20 seconds, anneal at 61°C for 10 seconds, and extension at 70°C for 15 seconds.
Perform a final extension at 70°C for 1 minute.
Pool all amplification reactions in a 1.5 mL eppendorf tube.
Prepare PCR purification using NucleoSpin Gel and PCR purification kit in a 0.5 mL Eppendorf tube.
Elute the purified sample in 17 μl Elution Buffer.
Expect above 10 ng/μl of double-stranded oligos.
Dilute linearized vector to 100 ng/μl.
Dilute double-stranded oligo pool to 12.5 ng/μl.

Prepare a ligation mix in PCR strips by combining 2 μl of 5X In-Fusion mix, 2 μl of linearized vector at 100 ng/μl, and 2 μl of double-stranded oligo pool at 12.5 ng/μl, then add 4 μl of Nuclease-free water.
Prepare a no-insert mix in PCR strips by combining 2 μl of linearized vector with 8 μl of Nuclease-free water.
Incubate the ligation and no-insert mixes at 50°C for 15 minutes.
Dilute both ligation mix and no-insert mix to 24 μl with Nuclease-free water.
Transform 2 μl of ligation mix per tube using NEB 5-alpha high efficiency competent cells according to manufacturer instructions.
Pool cells diluted in SOC after recovery.
Perform four serial dilutions on an aliquot of pooled cells.
Plate equal volumes of each dilution on LB + Carbenicillin plates to calculate transformation efficiency.
Inoculate 1.5 L of LB + Carbenicillin liquid media with the remainder of the cell mixture, split across 3 maxi prep flasks.
Incubate plates at 37°C for 12 hours or greater.
Incubate liquid media in a shaking incubator at 37°C for 12 hours or greater.
Calculate library coverage from the amount of transformed cells pre-dilution, total amount of pooled cell mixture, and number of unique oligos in the library.
Plasmid coverage = number of transformants / number of oligos
Seed one 60 mm tissue culture dish with 1.2 million HEK-293T cells one day prior to transfection and incubate overnight at 37°C and 5% atmospheric CO2.
Prepare transfection mixes for each of the plasmids of interest.
Add 2 μg of plasmid, 1.3 μg of pRD114, and 2 μg of pHIT60 to 400 μL OptiMEM and mix by pipetting.
For a lentiviral vector, add 2.8 μg of plasmid, 2.1 μg of psPAX1, and 0.7 μg of pMD2.G to 400 μL OptiMEM and mix by pipetting.
Add 16.8 μL TransIT-293 reagent to the plasmid mixture and mix gently by pipetting.
Incubate the solution at room temperature for 15-30 minutes.
Add the TransIT-293 reagent-plasmid mixture dropwise to different areas of the HEK-293T cells.
Gently rock the culture vessel to evenly distribute the solution.
Filter the viral supernatant using a 0.45 μm syringe filter and 10 mL syringe.
Use viral supernatant for subsequent transduction or aliquot the remaining viral supernatant into 1.5 mL tubes.
Freeze the aliquoted viral supernatant at -80°C for future use.
Add 1 mL of a 0.2 million Jurkat cells/mL C10 media to a 6-well plate.
Add 1.5 mL of viral supernatant to the 6-well plate containing the media.
Add 2.5 μL polybrene (1000x) and mix by gently rocking the plate.
Spin infect the cells at 30°C for 1.5 hours at 2500 rpm.
Carefully aspirate away the media after centrifugation.
Replace with fresh media and culture the cells in the incubator.
Resuspend 15 million K562 cells in a premixed solution of 12 mL C10 media, 12 μL polybrene, and 3 μL viral supernatant.
Evenly distribute the mixture among the wells of a 6-well plate.
Spin infect the cells at 30°C for 1.5 hours at 2500 rpm.
Carefully aspirate away the media after centrifugation.
Replace with fresh media and culture the cells in the incubator.
Allow at least 2 days for growth and recovery of the cells after transduction.
Assess transduction efficiency using flow cytometry, staining for relevant transduction markers.
Sort the transduced cells by FACS.
Culture the cells as described previously.
Proceed to coculture step or aliquot extra cells in Bambanker freeze media.
Freeze the aliquots at -80°C overnight.
Transfer the aliquots to liquid nitrogen for long-term storage.
Wash Jurkat TCR and K562 library cells twice at 100g for 5 minutes, replacing with fresh C10 media each time.
Resuspend Jurkat TCR cells at 5.2 million/mL in fresh C10 media.
Resuspend K562 library cells at 2.6 million/mL in fresh C10 media.
Add 500 μl of resuspended Jurkat TCR cells to a sterile 5 ml round-bottom polystyrene tube.
Add 500 μl of resuspended K562 library cells to the same tube containing Jurkat TCR cells, mixing gently by pipetting.
Coculture the mixed cells for 45 minutes at 37°C and 5% CO2.
Prepare staining solution by adding 12.5 μl of LIVE/DEAD Fixable Violet Dead Cell Stain and 25 μl of anti-muTCR-PECy7 to 5 ml of FACS buffer.
Spin down cells for 5 minutes at 500g after coculture incubation.
Resuspend samples in 1 ml of 2 mM EDTA in PBS, then spin down again.
Resuspend the cell samples in 650 μl of staining solution and incubate for 20 minutes on ice and in the dark.
Add 1 ml FACS buffer to wash cells, then spin down for 5 min.
Repeat wash step with 1 ml FACS buffer.
Resuspend the samples in 500 μl of sterile Trogocytosis Resuspension Solution made as needed. Keep the cells on ice until sorting.
Filter the sample using a 5 mL Falcon test tube with cell strainer snap cap.
Sort Crimson-eGFP+TCR+ cells to a sterile 5 mL round-bottom polystyrene tube containing at least 1 mL of C10 medium.
Culture the sorted cells until sufficient growth is achieved.
Extract genomic DNA from approximately 1 million sorted cells using the PureLink Genomic DNA Mini Kit.
Dilute the extracted genomic DNA products to 50 ng/μL.

Set up PCR reactions with each sample run alongside a no-template control: Add 2X Kapa HIFI MM, TruSeq-Univ-SCTfixed-F primer, TruSeq-Read2-SCTfixed-R primer, TruSeq-Adapter-Index-1 index primer, template DNA, and nuclease-free water as specified.

Run the PCR samples using a program that includes initial denaturation at 95°C for 2 min, followed by 30 cycles of denaturation at 95°C for 20 sec, annealing at 66°C for 10 sec, extension at 70°C for 15 sec, and a final extension at 70°C for 2 min, with the reaction held at 4°C.
Pool each sample after PCR amplification.
Purify pooled samples using the DNA Clean & Concentrator-5 Kit.
Elute purified DNA in 20 μL of water.
Run 4 μL of purified PCR products on an agarose gel to verify amplification.
Quantify amplified barcoded DNA by Bioanalyzer.
Sequence amplified barcoded DNA using the Illumina Genome Analyzer IIx System.
Create a sample sheet with Illumina Experiment Manager to define indexes.
Configure bclToFastq: configureBclToFastq.pl --input-dir <path_to_BaseCalls_dir> --output-dir <path_to_output_dir> --sample-sheet <path_to>/SampleSheet.csv
Run bclToFastq using the makefile generated by the configuration script.
Replace the 2kb BsmBI stuffer sequence in pCCLc-MND-2kb stuffer-β2m-A2-IRES-eGFP with a string of random nucleotides (36 bp for 12 AA).
Build the bwa index: bwa index -p ref backbone.fasta
Align each sample to plasmid backbone using bwa.
Trim alignment to only include epitope region by adjusting start positions based on epitope and read starts.
For each codon, translate to peptide using the codon table.
For each amino acid sequence generated, count library peptide hits if present in the library sequences table.
